simple.meaning: גַּו (gav) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the middle.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 13 times across Ezra, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 4:15. Its contexts include family, kingship, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גַּו (H1459).

definitions.full: H1459. gav [ גַּו ] noun masculine midst (Egyptian Aramaic, Nabataean, Palmyrene גו ; גָּיו ᵑ7 ; especially construct מִגּוֺ לְגוֺ, בְּגוֺ, ; so Syriac ; compare Biblical Hebrew נֵּו ); — construct גּוֺא (so Nabataen Cooke No. 94 ) Dan 3:26 +, 7:15 editions, Gi גּוֺ (Baer גּוֺא , see on 3:6 ); suffix 3masculine singular גַּוֵּהּ Ezra 5:7 , 3 feminine singular גַּוַּהּ 4:15 ; 6:2 ; — midst , always with prepositions: a. בְּגוֺא (= Hebrew בְּתוֺךְ ), Dan 3:25 גוּרָא בְּגוֺא , 4:7 ; 7:15 ; Ezra 4:15 ; 5:7 בְּגַוֵהּ כְּתִיב וְכִדְנָה , 6:2 . b. לְגוֺא Dan 3:6 , 11 , 15 , 21 , 23 , 24 . c. מִןגּֿוֺא Dan 3:26 . גֵּרָה see גאה .
